countries.reasoning: Based on USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024, China is the dominant global producer of magnesium metal with well-documented production data and consistent annual reporting.
Russia has significant production capacity documented by national industry reports and USGS 2024; data is reliable but less comprehensive than China's.
Israel produces magnesium primarily from the Dead Sea; data from national sources and USGS reports indicate steady production, though smaller scale.
Kazakhstan's magnesium production is reported in regional trade and mineral industry data; data is somewhat limited but production is stable.
US production is documented from primary sources and USGS 2024; production is moderate and steadily reported but lower than top producers.
